scope: One PX Cask expression; not completion of the Laphroaig distillery catalog.

facts.evidence: Official product page confirms Islay single malt, ex-bourbon barrels followed by quarter casks and PX sherry butts; nose sultanas/raisins/liquorice, palate peat/oak/sweet heavy sherry, finish long and dry with peat and sherried oak.
facts.ageEvidence: The official PX Cask expression has no numeric age statement.
facts.abvEvidence: 48% was also read from the bottle and box in the real product photograph.

photo.review: Root viewed local photo: PX Cask Triple Matured bottle and box, 48% and 1L visible.
